SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.name FROM `org` o LEFT JOIN org_member m ON m.tenant_id = o.id AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN workspace_role r ON r.id = m.role_id AND r.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.status = 0
AND (o.owner_id = #{userId} OR r.access_level = 'ADMIN')
ORDER BY o.id DESC
SELECT tenant_id AS workspaceId, COUNT(*) AS total FROM agent WHERE tenant_id IN #{workspaceId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND kind = 'STANDARD' GROUP BY tenant_id
SELECT tenant_id AS workspaceId, COUNT(*) AS total FROM squad WHERE tenant_id IN #{workspaceId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0 GROUP BY tenant_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.user_id) FROM org_member m JOIN `user` u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.tenant_id IN #{workspaceId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0
